entities.summary: Mattia Binotto is an Italian motorsport engineer. Since 2025, Binotto has been the head of the Audi F1 Project, becoming its team principal after the departure of Jonathan Wheatley in early 2026. From 2019 to 2022, he served as the team principal of Italian Formula One team Scuderia Ferrari in Formula One.
